label: VECTOR_DISTANCE() function
type: SQL++ function returning an exact distance between two vectors by brute-force comparison, without using a vector index
note: Re-filed from vector-index:vector-distance-function on the same evidence as n1ql:approx-vector-distance - the page links it as n1ql/n1ql-language-reference/vectorfun.md#vector_distance. The old id also carried a category word in its local name ('-function') that its sibling did not, so one pair of functions was spelled two ways; the n1ql: namespace names neither n1ql:create-function-statement nor n1ql:curl-function-function. Contrast with n1ql:approx-vector-distance: 'The VECTOR_DISTANCE function performs a brute-force full vector comparison, so it returns the most accurate results' and 'this function does not use a vector index'.
